title: StepConfigErrorResponse
description: 422 body for a pipeline execution (step preview, Output preview, dry run, real run) refused because a step's own configuration is missing or invalid (HEL-1147). `message` is the unchanged generic error text (it carries the step id and lane path) so `extractErrorMessage` and every existing reader keep working; `code`, `stepId`, `stepKind` and `reason` are the structured addition. Failures caused by data, an unresolved lane/source reference or an external provider are NOT this shape and keep the plain `{message}` body.

stepId.description: The failing step. May be an ancestor of the previewed step.

reason.description: The step's own problem description, without any step id or lane-path prefix.
